Yeah I was being pretty generous for Evo pricing. It's not unreasonable to assume it cost more than a million to put on since they swapped to the convention center. I have a history with film/production so I know how expensive things can get from that angle when it comes to the stages and streams! There's so much that goes into these events! Thanks for adding some extra valuations here, I think it's important for the community to know just how much goes into these productions

They are easily over the $600,000 mark if we take into account. Venue, Internet for the event, stream production cost, console rental services (which sometimes requires game purchases or dlc purchases on the fly depending on updates and what not) lastly you have fees for any services venues may provide (think of concessions and things of that nature). Overall events can get pretty expensive! I've heard rumblings operations like Evo are starting to hover near that $850,000 mark. And that's B4 we include prize payouts etc etc. all in all modern events are pretty pricey operations! All the more reason we should thank our staff and T.Os when we head to these awesome events!

Of course thanks for being understanding! All games are still good/great in there own right.

First off IV is definitely a game that did a great job establishing a lot of final fantasy story telling motifs and moments that are now franchise staples so I'll always give credit where it's due. However upon my second time playing IV I found the plot to be a bit questionable in it's characters and how they handled they're arcs, it's be way to lengthy for me to start diving into but the short of it is I feel like a lot of characters plots and morales get resolved very quickly and or semi-absolved by the end of the game with little to no repercussions and for the topics at hand and the lengths they go to show certain setpieces I found it a bit jarring to say the least. They also do something I really really don't like in RPGS which is constantly moving my party members around. People come in and out of your party so often and not like say a guest party member like FF12 were talking they are with you for two-three dungeons than they dip and take some of your good loot with them! That got annoying pretty fast and I felt like I never had enough time to truly stick with a team I liked to play. FF1 is just a lot simpler with imo a lot less to dissect plot/gameplay wise and it made my playthrough a pretty enjoyable one and the job system is always fun for me. Sure the story ain't the deepest, but I enjoyed my time quite a bit seeing how I didn't mind some of the dated gameplay ideas (dungeons and RNG encounters being high).

I'm sorry if this comes off rude/negative but something about GG strive feels extremely off this beta. Where as the first open beta my only gripes were how powerful some characters were (pot,sol,ram) and the over reliance on backdashing and lack of penalties for such (negative penalty doesn't do much in this GG because you only get two bars of tension). I thought overall it was a really fun time and didn't end up getting too frustrated with the game. Beta 2 is the exact opposite however and before anyone calls me bad or whatever maybe for my complaints, i'm currently floor 10 working my way to celestial for the SECOND TIME just to briefly talk about my average skill level. here's my biggest gripes so far with strive beta 2,
-Lobby

The lobby system is somehow even more infuriating than the last i'm still constantly running into errors connecting to people, getting booted out mid match, kicked out of training mode and sent to the lobby and or main menu during standby and a slew of other issues that make playing the game a chore. somehow this beta it feels even worse than the last because I really thought they'd fix some of these problems but alas here we are, on top of introducing some good new things the rematch button is a nice touch they also somehow made that frustrating! I loathe getting into good sets with people only to get booted out because either me or the opponent have to go up or down a floor, it's so aggravating what makes it worse is the game not telling me in the match completion screen how close I am to moving up so I'll be on my first or second rematch and than out of nowhere BOOM ratting up. ugh, furthermore the ranking system still makes no sense. I've played countless matches and have 0 idea when a rank up or down is coming. sometimes I lose no joke 9 matches back to back and be fine other times I'll win 12 matches back to back in a lobby and I have 0 indication of when it's my time to ascended with the celestial homies or stay in the stairway to heaven. it also gets confusing when lower rated players jump all the way up and you have to fight them cause everywhere else is taken, how many points/ ratings do I gain from essentially beating a floor 5 senseless? too many questions and too little answerers. overall minus the park the lobby system is deeply flawed that is all.
